title: rechargeable salt and pepper shakers
text:
rechargeable salt and pepper shakers. My sister saw my set on the counter and tried to stuff them in her purse. Ha! So I sent these to her. They are awesome. So easy to use. There is a button on the side to use, or, just turn them over. Charge them up and the charge lasts for weeks. I have several rechargeable items so I just put them all on chargers each Sunday. Just part of my routine. These can go WAY longer than one week though. Comes with the charger cords. I had already replaced one of my outlets to include several USB ports - so it's easy peasy to charge about anything right on the counter overnight. The grind is easily adjustable so you can go fine, medium or coarse and back really fast with a turn of a dial on the top of each grinder. Also comes with a little cleaning brush to sweep out any coarse ground corns or salt crystals, but I haven't had to do that. The collapsible funnel is silicone or like and is easy to store and use with almost anything you need to fill.
Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
